events.label: SPCX lockup first tranche — 911.5M shares (20%) eligible; first-session −13.6%, below IPO price
events.note: Updated Aug 6 morning: first-session selloff −13.6% confirms insiders are selling the first 20% tranche. Stock at ~$93, below the $135 IPO price and 59% off the June $225 ATH. The diagnostic set up pre-market (volume below 50M = absorbed, above 150M with price below support = front-running) has resolved toward the latter. December backstop expiry is now the structural floor; next unlock trigger is post-Q3 earnings (~October). Q3 Starlink profitability and AI segment revenue above $2B are the only catalysts that could interrupt the liquidation template before December.

events.label: US-Iran Hormuz interim deal — Bessent Aug 4 deadline passed; 50:50 odds by Friday
events.note: Updated Aug 6 morning: Bessent's 'today or tomorrow' call from August 4 lapsed without a signing. Tehran says the Iran-Oman navigation-coordinate agreement is a necessary step but insufficient for a formal reopening. WTI holds $74.69, pricing progress but not certainty. 60-day interim via Oman allows safe inbound/outbound shipping. Signing opens next oil leg toward $68-70 as Persian Gulf supply restores. A collapse: WTI rebounds above $78, both oil-side triggers re-breach, September approaches 70% from combined oil + Kashkari pressure. The deal has failed twice in 2026. Transmission: airlines (fuel cost deflation), consumer discretionary (disposable income), logistics. Energy producers face headwinds until OPEC+ responds.

events.label: July NFP (BLS, 8:30 AM ET) — September hike binary; ADP 44K signals downside risk
events.note: Updated Aug 6 morning: September hike sits at 54% (down from 58% post-Kashkari on Aug 5), 16 points from the 70% formal trigger. NFP consensus 80-100K (prior 57K); ADP 44K argues for downside surprise at this magnitude of deviation. Below 70K: September drops toward 40-45%, Kashkari isolated as one-of-three dissenters, 30Y path toward 5.00%. Above 130K: three dissenters validated, September through 70%, 30Y extends toward 5.28%, equities reprice from record. In 70K-130K band: September holds 50-65%, Kashkari live but not decisive. FOMC September 15-16.

events.label: July CPI (est.) — Iran oil re-surge and tariff pass-through fully embedded
events.note: Updated Aug 5 night: July CPI embeds the pre-ceasefire Brent average (~$85-91/bbl) from the Iran escalation period; the August collapse to ~$75 likely doesn't appear in the comp yet. Kashkari's August 5 hawkish call frames the read: above 3.5% validates Kashkari's inflation thesis and makes September near-certain regardless of NFP; below 3.0% opens the formal 30Y clearing path toward 5.00% and removes the inflation anchor for Kashkari's view. Either print resets the Jackson Hole framing. Gold's +5.3% on August 5 ($4,304) is the market's forward price of a hot print.

events.label: NVDA Q2 FY27 earnings (est.) — SpaceX exclusive Vera Rubin deal raises the entry bar to $220
events.note: Updated Aug 5 night: Musk confirmed on SpaceX's earnings call that SpaceX will build AI infrastructure 'exclusively' on Nvidia's Vera Rubin, targeting 2GW compute by year-end and 10GW by end-2027. NVDA surged to ~$220 on the news. AMD's AH −8% on a genuine beat (from an elevated entry) establishes the AI hardware selloff pattern at elevated valuations. At $220, Q2 FY27 call watch: (1) Gross margin above 76% — the SpaceX commitment and AMD's AH selloff both argue that the market is scrutinizing margin quality more than revenue. (2) Q3 guide above consensus — SpaceX 10GW and AVGO $128.1B pipeline confirm hyperscaler demand; the question is whether NVDA's supply can convert that demand into margin. (3) Circular financing disclosure — OpenAI $250B backstop still unaddressed. $216 now functions as support (former stop level).

events.label: Jackson Hole Economic Policy Symposium (Aug 27–29) — Warsh keynote on September FOMC path
events.note: Updated Aug 5 night: September hike probability is now ~58% (Kalshi), up from 54% after Kashkari's explicit call for gradual hikes. The keynote arrives after NFP (Aug 7) and CPI (Aug 13). Three FOMC dissenters now publicly aligned with September (from a committee of 12). Consequential path: NFP above 130K then CPI above 3.5% then Warsh as lock-in signal — September near-certain. Inverse: NFP below 80K then CPI below 3.0% then Warsh de-escalates and 30Y retreats toward 5.00%. If a second non-dissenting official endorses September before Aug 27, Warsh's framing is effectively constrained.

events.label: SPCX 180-day IPO lock-up expiry (approx.) — insider/early-investor float unlock
events.note: ~180 days after the June 12 debut. Lock-up expiries are a known supply overhang for hot IPOs. Early investors and insiders can sell, materially expanding the ~4% public float. Context: SPCX Q2 showed $18.37B capex vs $7.81B revenue (2.35x capex-to-revenue ratio); AI segment $2.56B (+247% YoY). SpaceX exclusive Nvidia deal (announced Aug 5) confirms the AI infrastructure build is real but the November Q3 print is the next test of whether capex is generating proportional AI revenue growth before the lock-up.

events.label: OpenAI IPO — target window shifts to H1 2027 after 2026 delay
events.note: OpenAI delayed its anticipated 2026 IPO to H1 2027 (announced June 26, 2026). Microsoft and NVIDIA hold strategic stakes. PLTR's 149% US commercial growth (Aug 3), AMD's $6.7B data-center (+107%), and SpaceX's exclusive Nvidia commitment ($15.83B AI capex) all confirm the enterprise AI adoption that underlies OpenAI's revenue model. NVDA circular financing disclosure ($250B OpenAI backstop) remains the unresolved structural question that may surface in S-1 filings.
